text:
Maria C.: Early pulse - I'm on AM triage. Queue at 47 open tickets (P1=2, P2=3). Did quick cleanup on billing hits and updated two reply macros. Blocker: webhook retry bug causing duplicate callbacks and refund noise (ticket #3456). Assigning to eng-infra now.

Derek H.: Noted. Overnight we had ~28 webhook failures clustered between 02:40-03:10 UTC. Putting a temporary alternate-callback macro in high-touch cases. @Maria C. I added a short notice to any refund threads.

triage-bot: Snapshot: total_open=47; p1=2; p2=3; p3=15; awaiting_customer=20; awaiting_internal=7; new_since_last=6

Sam P.: Picking up the P1 latency regression (payments path). I have traces and a repro attached to ticket #3499. Need runtime eyes on trace ids: a7f1..b3 and c2d4..9e. @Anya I can forward the trace dump.

Anya I.: Forwarded to eng-runtime and tagged oncall. Also drafted a small customer macro for embed errors (suggests smaller batches + retry). Draft below: 

```
Hi {customer_name}, sorry for the disruption. You can try creating embeddings in batches of up to 8 items and retry. If you'd like, reply "please regen" and well run a one-time regeneration for the affected items. We're investigating a backend rate issue.
```

Maria C.: Nice wording, trimmed to fit SMS. Added to support/macros as "embed_batch_retry" and flagged for a quick review.

Derek H.: Escalation template for infra ops (paste as needed):

```
Subject: URGENT - webhook callbacks failing in payments
Summary: ~28 failed callbacks since 02:40 UTC; duplicate-refund symptom observed. Service: payments-webhook-prod. Example traces: a7f1..., c2d4...
Impact: P1-visible for ~6 customers; potential double-charge risk.
Action: hotfix retry/backoff + validate idempotency keys. Owner: eng-infra
```

Maria C.: Will use that for the external acknowledgment and loop in legal. :thumbsup: Also quick ask - can someone with console perms run a token reset for cust-803? Their sessions started failing after a KMS rotation.

Anya I.: I have console perms, doing token reset now. Will post when complete.

triage-bot: Macro change log: updated macros: embed_batch_retry, refund_ack_short, escalation_ops. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/support-macros/pull/219. Author: Anya I.

Maria C.: Reminder - backlog groom tonight 19:00 PT. Please tag any tickets that need eng attention with "needs-engine" before 18:30 so we can triage during the groom. Ill check back after eng-infra update. Thanks!
